genesis:2:en:20.originalText: So the man gave names to all the livestock, the birds in the sky and all the wild animals.
genesis:2:en:20.text:
So the man gave names to all the livestock, the birds in the sky and all the wild animals.
But for Adam no suitable helper was found.
